description: This file implements quota evaluators and utility functions for resource usage tracking in Kubernetes, including object count evaluation and quota matching logic.

classes.name: protectedLister
classes.description: A wrapper around cache.GenericLister that checks if the informer has synced before delegating list/get calls.

classes.name: protectedNamespaceLister
classes.description: A wrapper around cache.GenericNamespaceLister that checks if the informer has synced before delegating list/get calls.

classes.name: objectCountEvaluator
classes.description: An evaluator for counting objects based on the number of items returned by a listing function, used for quota enforcement.

methods.name: ListerFuncForResourceFunc
methods.description: Returns a function that provides a cached lister for a given resource, waiting until the informer has synced.

methods.name: cachedHasSynced
methods.description: Returns a function that calls hasSynced() until it returns true once, then always returns true.

methods.name: ObjectCountQuotaResourceNameFor
methods.description: Constructs the quota resource name for object count based on the groupResource.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Determines if a resource quota matches a given object based on resources and scopes.

methods.name: getScopeSelectorsFromQuota
methods.description: Extracts scope selectors from a ResourceQuota object.

methods.name: CalculateUsageStats
methods.description: Calculates aggregate resource usage for objects in a namespace, considering scopes and usage functions.

methods.name: NewObjectCountEvaluator
methods.description: Creates a new evaluator for counting objects for quota enforcement, with optional alias for legacy names.
